method: Python 3 calculated slot/count values and converted listed VAs to original file offsets; each listed instruction sequence was byte-compared to the original binary.

slot_formula.calculations: Python: 3 * 4; 15 * 12; len([irq for irq in range(16) if irq != 2]); len(range(8))

disable_and_record.instruction: PUSHFD; POP EAX; CLI; SHR EAX,9; AND EAX,1; store local

restore.instruction: PUSHFD; POP EAX; CMP saved,0; JZ CLI; otherwise STI

disable_and_record.instruction: PUSHFD; POP EAX; CLI; SHR EAX,9; saved bit

restore_before_helper_call.instruction: STI if saved bit, otherwise CLI; then pushes arguments and calls 0x0018c7b0

restore.instruction: PUSHFD; POP EAX; TEST saved bit; STI or CLI
PUSHFD; POP EAX; TEST saved bit; STI or CLI

unregister_slot_clear.instruction: three dword zero stores at slot +0, +4, +8

pic_write_and_locked_increment.instruction: when effective mask differs: write port 0x21, LOCK INC [0x001e7618], write port 0xa1, LOCK INC [0x001e7618]

post_unregister_helper_output.instruction: if 0x001e7720 changes: OUT 0x4d0, LOCK INC; OUT 0x4d1, LOCK INC

bounded_findings: The selected register and unregister paths use a 12-byte indexed slot and respectively populate or clear three dwords.
The selected register/unregister/enable/disable paths save the incoming IF bit after CLI and choose STI versus CLI before their shown exit or helper call.
The selected mask paths issue two port writes and two lock-prefixed increments only when their compared effective mask differs.
No claim is made about handler execution, hardware delivery, the meanings of mask fields, atomic progress, deadlock freedom, reentrancy, or runtime interrupt state.
